blind.description: A stylized wooden bakery shop counter featuring rectangular framing with dark green inset panels. The tabletop holds an assortment of baked goods: a shallow wooden crate with iced cinnamon buns, a braided loaf, two round scored bread loaves, a wicker basket filled with tall baguettes, and a tiered round cake topped with cherries/chocolate on a small display stand. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized in a hand-painted fantasy/game style.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden countertop oriented horizontally; the left side shows plain brown wooden boards, while the right side is densely arranged with a small square crate of four rolls, a braided bread loaf, two round bread boules, an oblong wicker basket filled with baguettes, and a round circular frosted cake on a stand.
blind.height_vs_figure: The counter table stands roughly half the height of the figure (about 2.5 to 3 ft tall, with the bread reaching around 3.5 ft), and its length spans roughly 5 ft.
